chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Musa ibn Bakr from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
"When you pray over the woman, stand at her head, and when you pray over the man, stand at his chest."

key_terms.صَلَّيْتَ: you prayed (specifically funeral prayer in this context)

ai.seo_question: Where should the Imam stand during the funeral prayer for a woman versus a man?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the specific standing positions for the Imam during Salat al-Mayyit, distinguishing between the head for women and the chest for men. This distinction reflects the scholarly tradition regarding the orientation of the deceased and the Imam's proximity to the body, ensuring the ritual is performed with precision and reverence as recorded in Al-Tusi's Tahdhib al-Ahkam.
